tasks.title: Documentation evidence baseline
tasks.initialPrompt: Survey this repository documentation and developer workflow with repository tools. Start with file_tree, then inspect README, build configuration, and focused source ranges. Keep exploring concrete evidence until the runner asks you to wrap up. Write concise evidence-backed notes under .codexplorer/artifacts/baseline.md using create_file or write_text. Do not modify repository source files, tests, or configuration. Keep task-owned notes inside .codexplorer/artifacts/. Avoid web tools for this task.
